name: Juniper Aperture
description: A single offset portrait, an open elliptical aperture and a juniper branch trailing into generous prose.

name: Vapour Column
description: A tall condenser coil runs beside a writing-led page with a large italic heading and a fine measuring scale.

name: London Cut
description: A sharp typographic cover with two adjoining cinematic GIF panels, bevelled corners and a stepped member-colour frame.

name: Orris Folio
description: A narrow title column accompanies the writing, with a delicate botanical specimen and a three-colour colophon.

name: Tonic Refraction
description: An airy fluted-glass frame with a wide heading, uninterrupted prose and two faceted portraits at the foot.

name: Juniper Signal
description: A softly squared smartphone with an oblong contact portrait, three status lights and a curved message dock.

name: Stillwave
description: A music-player-inspired message phone with a large time display, a waveform dock and a circular hardware dial.

name: Dryline Mini
description: A compact e-ink messenger with a tiny square portrait, an outlined screen and perforated speaker grille.

name: Botanica Relay
description: A landscape communicator with a side control rail, paired contact tiles and a wide conversation screen.

name: Gimlet Glass
description: A wrist communicator with a ribbed strap, a small contact tile and rounded message cards inside a soft glass bezel.

name: Berrylet
description: An open miniature note held between staggered corner brackets, finished with three tiny juniper berries.

name: Zest Curl
description: A square portrait hangs beside a compact reply, with an airy spiral and a fine coloured baseline.

name: Angelica Knot
description: A narrow note with a fine crossing ribbon, an inset title tab and a short writing panel.

name: Two Measures
description: A tiny tasting card places its reply above two glass-bottom portrait tiles and a centred name label.

name: Frostlet
description: A low, wide reply with a small square portrait, offset grid marks and a translucent angular corner.
